mapper.sql: biz52_erp_fee_id AS erp_fee_id , biz52_erp_cont_corp_id AS erp_cont_corp_id , biz52_start_date AS start_date , biz52_close_date AS close_date , biz52_erp_fee AS erp_fee , biz52_data_fee AS data_fee , biz52_charge_day AS charge_day , biz52_vat_cd AS vat_cd , biz52_deposit_due_day AS deposit_due_day , biz52_add_fee_sms_yn AS add_fee_sms_yn , biz52_add_fee_server_yn AS add_fee_server_yn , biz52_add_fee_user_yn AS add_fee_user_yn , biz52_sms_base_count AS sms_base_count , biz52_sms_add_price AS sms_add_price , biz52_server_base_usage AS server_base_usage , biz52_server_add_unit AS server_add_unit , biz52_server_add_price AS server_add_price , biz52_user_base_count AS user_base_count , biz52_user_add_price AS user_add_price , biz52_user_count_std_cd AS user_count_std_cd , biz52_charge_calc_month_type AS charge_calc_month_type
mapper.select: SELECT , f_cdnm('DateCode', biz52_charge_day, #{companyId}, biz52_start_date) AS charge_day_str , f_cdnm('DateCode', biz52_deposit_due_day, #{companyId}, biz52_start_date) AS deposit_due_day_str , f_cdnm('VatCode', biz52_vat_cd, #{companyId}, biz52_start_date) AS vat_nm , f_cdnm('UserCountStdMonthCode', biz52_user_count_std_cd, #{companyId}, biz52_start_date) AS user_count_std_str , f_cdnm('MonthType', biz52_charge_calc_month_type, #{companyId}, biz52_start_date) AS charge_calc_month_type_nm FROM biz52_erp_fee WHERE biz52_erp_cont_corp_id = #{erpContCorpId} ORDER BY biz52_start_date DESC

SELECT , f_cdnm('DateCode', biz52_charge_day, #{companyId}, biz52_start_date) AS charge_day_str , f_cdnm('DateCode', biz52_deposit_due_day, #{companyId}, biz52_start_date) AS deposit_due_day_str , f_cdnm('VatCode', biz52_vat_cd, #{companyId}, biz52_start_date) AS vat_nm , f_cdnm('UserCountStdMonthCode', biz52_user_count_std_cd, #{companyId}, biz52_start_date) AS user_count_std_str , f_cdnm('MonthType', biz52_charge_calc_month_type, #{companyId}, biz52_start_date) AS charge_calc_month_type_nm FROM biz52_erp_fee WHERE biz52_erp_cont_corp_id = #{erpContCorpId} AND #{stdDate} >= biz52_start_date ORDER BY biz52_start_date DESC LIMIT 1
